ios.desc:
Drink Now – Water Reminder & Hydration Tracker

Staying hydrated should be simple. Drink Now helps you build healthy hydration habits with smart reminders, effortless tracking, and a clean interface designed for iOS & macOS.

Whether you are working, studying, or relaxing, Drink Now gently reminds you to drink water and keeps track of your daily intake so you can stay focused, energized, and healthy.

• Stay Consistently Hydrated

Set personalized water intake goals based on your routine and lifestyle. Drink Now helps you stay on track throughout the day without feeling overwhelming.

• Smart Water Reminders

Receive timely and customizable reminders that encourage you to drink water regularly. Adjust reminder frequency, schedule, and notification style to match your workflow.

• Easy Daily Tracking

Log your water intake quickly and easily. Monitor your progress, track hydration habits, and stay motivated to reach your daily goals.

• Build Healthy Habits

Consistent reminders help you create long-term wellness routines and improve overall hydration.

Designed for macOS

• Clean and distraction-free interface
• Lightweight and fast performance
• Seamlessly integrates into your daily workflow
• Privacy-friendly with local data tracking

Privacy policy: https://digitalhole.github.io/drinknow.html
Standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
